tokens.name: pistachio-50
tokens.usage: Faint pistachio wash for large quiet areas, e.g. behind the menu grid.

tokens.name: pistachio-100
tokens.usage: Pista Mist. Menu cards and soft panels. olive-800 text on it is 8.7:1.

tokens.name: pistachio-200
tokens.usage: Chip and tab hover fills; selected-row tint.

tokens.name: pistachio-500
tokens.usage: THE brand colour. Seal scallop, primary button fill, big blocks, ribbons. Never used for text: on cream it is only 1.9:1. Put olive-900 on it (5.7:1).

tokens.name: pistachio-600
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for pistachio buttons (olive-900 text still 4.7:1).

tokens.name: olive-900
tokens.usage: Text and icons that sit ON pistachio-500 or pistachio-600.

tokens.name: olive-800
tokens.usage: Olive Ink. Primary text, headings, secondary button outline, dark sections (cream text on it is 9.7:1).

tokens.name: olive-600
tokens.usage: Muted body text, captions and secondary info on cream or mist (7.2:1 on cream).

tokens.name: olive-400
tokens.usage: Form control borders and decorative icons only (3.7:1 on cream). Not for text.

tokens.name: copper-500
tokens.usage: Accent. The seal's centre, short rules, the focus ring, small highlights. Keep it under about 5% of any screen. Not for text on light grounds (3.2:1).

tokens.name: copper-700
tokens.usage: Copper you can read: eyebrow labels like KITCHEN and small emphasis text on cream (6.6:1).

tokens.name: copper-100
tokens.usage: Copper tint for a rare highlight panel such as a seasonal special.

tokens.name: butter-200
tokens.usage: Butter. Warm secondary ground, and text on olive-800 (7.9:1).

tokens.name: cream-50
tokens.usage: Page background. The default ground everywhere.

tokens.name: parchment-100
tokens.usage: Alternate section background to separate bands on the page.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Raised cards and the header when scrolled.

tokens.name: line-200
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders (decorative, not a control edge).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px copper-500 outline with 2px offset (3.2:1 on cream).

tokens.name: danger-600
tokens.usage: Errors only, e.g. a form field message (6.5:1 on cream).

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Home hero only. On phones, drop to display-lg.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Menu item names and card titles.

styles.name: accent-italic
styles.usage: Taglines, pull quotes and the second line of hero headings. Use it once per screen.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Cakes, cupcakes and bento treats from a home kitchen in Ndola.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every order is baked fresh and iced by hand.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Buttons, nav links and inline emphasis.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Item notes, captions and footer text.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Prices. Always write K with no space, and a comma from K1,000.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase labels above headings, in copper-700 or olive-600.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip padding, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button gap, scallop radius on dividers.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone side gutter; small card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; grid gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop side gutter; heading to content.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Space between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Hero top padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Photos inside cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero image frame and big feature panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, tabs. Every clickable control is a pill.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting cards.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Hovered cards and the scrolled header.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: The hero cake photo and the mobile menu sheet.

duration.note: How long things take. Everything eases out; nothing bounces.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Colour and fill changes on hover or press.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Tab indicator slide, card lift, menu open.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Page-section transitions and the category switch cross-fade.

tokens.name: duration-reveal
tokens.usage: Scroll reveals: fade in and rise 16px. Stagger siblings by 60ms.

tokens.name: duration-seal-spin
tokens.usage: One full turn of the seal's name ring in the hero. Pauses on hover.

easing.note: Curves. rise for things arriving, soft for things responding.

tokens.name: ease-rise
tokens.usage: Reveals and anything entering the screen.

tokens.name: ease-soft
tokens.usage: Hover, press, tab indicator.

tokens.name: ease-inout
tokens.usage: Things moving across the screen and back, like the mobile menu sheet.
